title: Coin-karaoke owners' press conference against government closure orders
notes: The S420 News1-origin account says nine Korean Coin Karaoke Association members held a press conference outside the National Assembly, demanding an end to long closure orders and compensation. S419 is by Dong-A Ilbo reporters Kim So-young and Lee Ji-woon, with News1 credited only for a photo/caption; the written relationship between the two accounts is not established, so S419 is not treated as automatic independent corroboration.

title: Cafe owners' relay one-person demonstrations against operating restrictions
reason: No public gathering of at least 50 is documented
notes: Yonhap's Jan. 6 report includes a caption of one association member at a relay demonstration outside the National Assembly and says organizers planned one-person demonstrations in Seoul and Sejong. A News1-origin report says cafe owners also used one-person protests. Individual relay actions do not establish 50 simultaneous participants.

title: Gwangju bars and nightclubs' announced sign-lighting action
reason: No public gathering; execution of the announced venue-based action is unconfirmed
notes: Yonhap's Jan. 6 report says around 700 Gwangju bars and nightclubs planned to open and light signs without serving customers. The report describes plans, not confirmed execution at each venue, and no people gathering together.

title: Bar and internet-cafe operators' Constitutional Court petition against COVID restrictions
reason: Petition filing does not establish a qualifying public gathering
notes: Yonhap reports that business owners and a civic group filed a petition seeking compensation and equal treatment. It gives no attendee count or evidence of a public gathering of at least 50.

title: Online petition seeking more flexible fitness-facility operating rules
reason: Online signatures are not public gathering attendance
notes: A News1-origin report republished by Dong-A says an online petition had more than 200,000 supporters. Those signatures do not establish a physical gathering.

title: Gym and fitness operators' business reopening in defiance of closure rules
reason: Commercial reopening is not a documented public gathering of at least 50
notes: Yonhap reports that gym businesses resumed operations in defiance of restrictions, and News1-origin coverage describes some operators reopening. Counts of operators or premises do not establish simultaneous protest attendance.
